title: 垃圾场拓展：分区拾荒与声望成长 / Scrapyard Expansion
author: Cycbloom
changeNote: 1.0.10：地面扩展改为默认关闭的独立选项，旧版本升级保留尺寸偏好；兼容储物窗口拖动缩放 Container Window Scale，由对方管理地面位置与缩放，避免覆盖拖动布局；关闭扩展仍可使用区域地图、掉落和声望。切换后请应用并重启游戏。 / Make Ground expansion optional and off by default, preserving saved size preferences. Let Container Window Scale manage Ground position and scale without layout overrides. Regional scavenging, loot and reputation remain available with expansion off. Apply and restart after changing the toggle.
